title: The Gladiator Pit
logline: A captured soldier forced to fight in illegal pit matches begs a pilot to smuggle in a heavy weapon so they can blast their way out.

roles.description: Covered in scars, fiercely determined, refusing to break.
Flashy, loud, treats human life as cheap entertainment.
A massive, blood-stained crater on a dead moon.
A heavy gunship keeping the crowd in line.
The criminal organization funding the pit matches.

public_situation: The {role:pit_boss} is hosting the ultimate death match at the {role:fighting_arena}, drawing crowds from across the sector.
private_truth: The star fighter is a captured naval officer. They plan to blow a hole in the arena wall during the main event and escape.

beats.public_change: The arena locks its blast doors as the crowds pour in.

missions.reason: The boss hires the pilot to mine and deliver ferrite to reinforce the arena walls.
missions.private_fact: The walls have already been weakened by the fighter's previous sabotage attempts.

beats.public_change: The fighter survives the semi-finals but is heavily wounded.

missions.reason: The fighter begs the pilot to buy illegal plasma charges and drop them into the holding pens.
missions.private_fact: The boss catches wind of the delivery and doubles the guard patrol.

beats.public_change: The main event begins, and the fighter detonates the charges.

missions.reason: The fighter pays the pilot to destroy the guard gunship so they can escape the crater.
missions.private_fact: The pit boss hails the pilot, offering to double their pay if they turn their guns on the escaping fighter instead.

player_choice.prompt: The patrol is dead. The fighter is running for their ship, but the boss is offering a massive bounty.

options.label: Take the bounty and kill the fighter

resolutions.summary: The fighter blasts out of the arena and escapes. The pit boss is humiliated, and the arena is shut down by the authorities.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broke a captured soldier out of an illegal fighting pit.

resolutions.summary: The pilot guns down the fighter. The boss pays out the bounty, and the bloody games continue as usual.
The guard patrol pins the fighter down. They are dragged back to the pens to die in the next match.

loose_threads.detail: The arena's sensors have a built-in blind spot installed by a corrupt local magistrate.
The fighter wasn't captured in battle; they were sold to the pit boss by their own commanding officer.

radio_hooks: Massive crowds gather for the annual death match.

voice_direction.captured_fighter: Guttural, exhausted, speaks through gritted teeth.
voice_direction.pit_boss: Loud, theatrical, constantly hyping up the crowd.
